acceptance: A table lists each commit above with a verdict (released, unreleased, correction) and the evidence at core v0.5.0 for each unreleased verdict
Each unreleased passage is restored to its v0.5.0 text on main by pull request, and next still carries the newer text after main is merged into it
`npm run docs:check -- --docs-mode block` passes on main (pin) and on next (develop bundle)
The owner has confirmed the verdicts for any passage where the evidence is not conclusive
context: Decision gate: classification needs judgement; do not revert on a guess, ask the owner. Guardrails: never edit release-pin/; do not weaken a check. Known inconsistency left on main until the next pin: docs/benchmarks/support-status.md states 17, 12 and 12 queries because the v0.5.0 contract exports those values, while the v0.5.0 query catalog holds 93, 112 and 23; that one is bound by docs:check and is not in scope here.
description:
Problem: when main was cut over to the v0.5.0 release pin, only the four statements docs:check rejects were restored to v0.5.0 values. Other documentation merged after v0.5.0 was published is still live on benchbox.dev and may describe unreleased behaviour. Outcome: every statement on main is true for the pinned release, and each unreleased statement lives on next.

Scope to audit against core at tag v0.5.0 (commit dfe585e) and release-pin/: the remaining edits of #137 and #138 (catalog counts, scale-factor ranges, size tables, `measured at SF 0.01 to 10`); the accepted-versions list in docs/reference/public-contracts.md, which names 2.4 while the current version reads 2.3; and the other docs commits since the release: #118, #119, #121, #124, #125, #131, #139, #140, #142, #144. Statements that only correct an error that was already wrong at v0.5.0 stay on main.
